turns.user: A builder in Noida took Rs 35 lakh from me for a flat in 2021 and still has not given possession. What are my rights?
turns.reply: Namaste. Because the amount involved is large (over ₹10 lakh) and real estate matters can be legally complex, you should consult a lawyer [needs_lawyer]. However, as a consumer who paid for a service/flat and did not get possession, you have strong rights under consumer laws. You can generally file a consumer complaint within 2 years from when the possession was due, and choose the District/State Commission based on where you live or work. Since this is a high-value property dispute, a lawyer is best to guide you through the civil or consumer courts. If cost is a worry, you can check free legal aid via NALSA (helpline 15100). To help me understand better: Do you have a builder-buyer agreement and payment receipts? When was the possession originally promised?
